title: IVG Pro 12 Fresh Mint Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Fresh Mint IVG Pro 12 Prefilled Pods deliver a crisp Mint profile with a cooling Menthol edge for a refreshingly smooth vape. The flavour is bright and clear, offering a brisk, frosty finish that’s ideal for fans of clean, simple blends. Each refill pack contains a 2ml pod prefilled with 20mg Nicotine Salt e-liquid and a separate 10ml refill reservoir. Once assembled, the refill system automatically keeps the pod topped up while you vape, removing the need for messy refills or coil changes. Each set provides up to 12,000 puffs per kit depending on usage. Mesh coil technology ensures steady flavour and smooth MTL vapour, while the click-fit design allows for easy, leak-resistant setup. Designed exclusively for use with the IVG Pro 12 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. How to Set Up: Remove the red stoppers from the 2ml pod. Twist and remove the red safety cap from the 10ml refill reservoir. Insert the pod into the refill reservoir and press until they click into place. Slide the connected pod and refill unit into the device. Wait a few moments to allow the coil to saturate before vaping.
